claims.explanation: This drops the three terms \(6(7^{5/2})(5^{1/2})\), \(20(7^{3/2})(5^{3/2})\), and \(6(7^{1/2})(5^{5/2})\). They combine to \(1144\sqrt{35}\approx6767.9\), so they do affect the integer part. The full expansion is \(6768+1144\sqrt{35}\approx13535.899\), so the greatest integer less than it is \(13535\), not \(6768\).
